title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Afseer ("Service Provider", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, stores, and shares information when you use the BizApp365 application for mobile devices and web browsers, together with any related services (collectively, the "Application").
By using the Application, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Application.

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information you provide directly, information generated through your use of the Application, and limited technical information needed to operate and secure the service.
bullets: Account and profile information such as name, email address, phone number, company name, and login credentials
Business data you enter into the Application, including accounting, inventory, CRM, HR, and transaction records
Communications you send to us, including support requests and feedback
Device and usage information such as IP address, browser type, operating system, app version, and diagnostic logs
Cookies and similar technologies on the web version of the Application, where applicable

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use personal and business information to:
bullets: Provide, maintain, and improve the Application and related services
Authenticate users and enforce security, including multi-tenant data isolation
Process transactions and deliver features you request
Respond to support inquiries and communicate service updates
Monitor performance, troubleshoot errors, and prevent fraud or abuse
Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms and Conditions

sections.title: Legal Bases for Processing (EEA, UK, and Similar Regions)
paragraphs: Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we process personal data on the following grounds:
bullets: Performance of a contract when providing the Application you requested
Legitimate interests in securing and improving our services, subject to your rights
Consent where required, such as for optional communications or non-essential cookies
Compliance with legal obligations

sections.title: How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information only as described below:
bullets: With service providers who help us host, maintain, analyze, or support the Application, under contractual confidentiality and security obligations
With your organization’s authorized administrators when you use the Application as part of a business account
When required by law, regulation, legal process, or governmental request
To protect the rights, property, or safety of the Service Provider, users, or others
In connection with a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, with appropriate safeguards

sections.title: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: The Application may rely on third-party services that collect information according to their own policies. For example, Google Play Services may be used on Android devices. Review the Google terms at https://policies.google.com/privacy.
We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party websites or services linked from the Application.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal and business data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Application, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
When data is no longer required, we delete or anonymize it in accordance with our retention practices and applicable law.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We implement administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect your information, including tenant isolation for business data.
No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. You are responsible for safeguarding your device, credentials, and access to the Application.

sections.title: International Transfers
paragraphs: Your information may be processed in countries other than your own. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers of personal data.

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, or object to certain processing of your personal data, and to data portability or withdrawal of consent where processing is consent-based.
To exercise these rights, contact us at mail@afseer.com. We may need to verify your identity before responding. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The Application is not directed to children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16 without appropriate parental consent. Contact us if you believe we have collected such data.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the updated policy on this page and update the effective date. Material changes may also be communicated through the Application or by email where appropriate.
Previous versions are available upon request at mail@afseer.com.

sections.title: Contact Us
paragraphs: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, contact the Service Provider at mail@afseer.com or support@bizapp365.com.
